arpabet.title: What is ARPABET?
arpabet.description: ARPABET is a phonetic notation used to describe pronunciation with uppercase sound codes.

items.stress: Vowels can include stress markers like `AH0`, `EH1`, or `IY2`.
items.spacing: Write each sound separated by spaces, in the order the word is spoken.
items.example: Example: `JOSÉ` can be approximated as `HH OW0 Z EY1`.

arpabet.reference: Tip: start with a simple English approximation, then refine the sounds if the result still feels off.
